findings.explanation: Lean proves that UNKNOWNpt and EOFpt have the same row because both calls reduce to the same Nat-valued ARB. HOL4 specifies the row only for POSN. Assigning row 0 to UNKNOWNpt and row 1 to EOFpt satisfies its saved equation.
findings.repair:
private opaque locnrowOther : locn → Nat
def locnrow : locn → Nat
  | .POSN r _ => r
  | l => locnrowOther l
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Location

example : locnrow .UNKNOWNpt = locnrow .EOFpt := rfl

findings.explanation: Lean proves that applying the identity row update to UNKNOWNpt and EOFpt gives equal results. Both calls reduce to the same locn-valued ARB, independently of the update function. HOL4 specifies only the POSN case. Returning the input location on each of the other two cases satisfies its saved equation and gives distinct results.
findings.repair:
private opaque locnRowUpdateOther : (Nat → Nat) → locn → locn
def locn_rowupdate (f : Nat → Nat) : locn → locn
  | .POSN r c => .POSN (f r) c
  | l => locnRowUpdateOther f l
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Location

example : locn_rowupdate id .UNKNOWNpt = locn_rowupdate id .EOFpt := rfl
